name: Oga Quasi-National Park
description: Quasi-national park of the Oga Peninsula: the dramatic sea cliffs of Cape Nyudo and the Namahage winter tradition of the peninsula villages.
notes: Managed by Akita. The Namahage Museum and the cape's coast road are the draws.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
